Maine repo padha. Aapka sawal "session JSON ko kaise use karu" ek galat mental model se aa raha hai, aur wahi UX problem hai.

## Session JSON use nahi karna hota
`.memory/sessions/*.jsonl` raw archive hai. Isse aap ya agent seedha nahi padhte. Flow ye hai:

1. Hooks session capture karte hain.
2. `memo process` / `memo cycle` har 15 minute mein usse intents, tasks, errors aur decisions nikalta hai.
3. Ye `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` ban jata hai.
4. Agla Claude session shuru hone par `SessionStart` hook [src/context.js](src/context.js) ka summary apne aap context mein daal deta hai.

Is session ke start mein jo "Intent / Open errors / Active decisions" dikha, wahi iska output hai. Aapko kuch "attach" nahi karna. Problem ye hai ki ye kahin bataya nahi gaya aur README mein sirf `memo init` likha hai. Isliye user ko lagta hai ki JSON bana par kaam ka kuch nahi.

## Website par pivot nahi karna chahiye
- Memory repo ke andar `.memory/` mein Git ke saath rehti hai. Website par ye cloud aur account wala product ban jata hai, aur privacy ka sawal aa jata hai (`docs/SECURITY.md` ka poora point local-first hai).
- Har agent ke UI se connect karne ki zarurat nahi hai. Alag-alag agents ko jodne ka sabse sasta tareeka file hai:
  - Codex aur kai tools `AGENTS.md` khud padhte hain. Ye aapke `memo init` mein pehle se hai.
  - Gemini CLI `GEMINI.md` padhta hai, Cursor `.cursor/rules` padhta hai. Dono mein ek line likhni hai: "Read `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` first".
  - Isliye Codex ko poore adapter (P9) ke bina bhi basic support mil sakta hai. Capture baad ki baat hai, pehle read hona zaruri hai.

## UX ke liye kya karna chahiye (priority order)
1. **Ek command install**: `npx memo-cli init`, ya `npm i -g` ke baad `memo init`. Ye ek hi baar mein sab kare: repo setup, `memo setup claude`, scheduled task, aur key na ho to Groq key puchna. Abhi `git clone`, `node bin/memo.js install`, `init`, `setup claude` alag-alag hain, wahi thakane wala hissa hai.
2. **`memo init` ke end mein "Ab kya hoga" screen**: "Claude kholo, kaam karo. 15 min baad `memo status` chalao." Saath mein `memo status` mein "last captured session, kitne records bane" dikhao, taaki user ko proof mile ki ye kaam kar raha hai.
3. **`memo import`**: purane Claude sessions (`~/.claude/projects/...` ke transcripts) ek baar mein backfill karna. Aap "purani session add karna mushkil hai" bol rahe the, iska yahi hal hai. Capture code incremental offset se pehle hi transcripts padhta hai, to ye chhota kaam hai.
4. **`memo setup <agent>`**: `claude | codex | gemini | cursor` ek hi command se. Abhi sirf pehla chalta hai. Baaki teen ke liye shuru mein sirf instruction file likhni hai.
5. **Website sirf docs/landing page ho**, ya baad mein optional read-only viewer jo local `PROJECT_STATE.md` dikhaye. Model switch karne ki website zaruri nahi hai, kyunki memory model se independent file mein hai. Model badalna ek config line hai (`memo config`).

## Meri recommendation
Pivot mat karo. Ye hafte sirf teen kaam k
par customer ko session purana vala pata kese chalega aur voh vaha se start kese karega simple steps bata tuh user hai purana session ko connect kese karega bata

Customer ko purana session "connect" nahi karna padta. Use sirf ek baar `init` karna hai, aur purani history ek command se aani chahiye. Ek baat pehle: `memo import` abhi repo mein nahi hai. Neeche "aaj" aur "banana hai" alag likha hai.

## User ke steps (target flow)

1. **Install, ek baar:** `npm i -g memo-cli`.
2. **Apne project folder mein:** `memo init`. Ye `.memory/` banata hai, Claude hooks lagata hai, aur background task register karta hai.
3. **Purani history lao (ek baar):** `memo import`. Ye us project ke purane Claude sessions dhoondhta hai. Wo `~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl` mein pehle se padhe hote hain. Screen par dikhata hai: "12 purane sessions mile. Import karu? [Y/n]". Phir wahi extraction chalata hai.
4. **Check karo:** `memo status` dikhata hai "12 sessions, 53 records, last: 2 hours ago". Ye proof hai ki purana session ab memory ban gaya.
5. **Kaam shuru karo:** Claude kholo. Purani memory (kaam, errors, decisions) session ke start mein apne aap aa jati hai. User ko kuch attach nahi karna.

## Purane session ka pata kaise chalega
- Claude Code purane sessions pehle se disk par rakhta hai, to user ko file dhoondhni nahi padti. `memo import` unhe project path se match karta hai.
- User ko kuch "dikhta" bhi chahiye: `memo sessions` ek list dikhaye, jaise `date | session id | summary ki pehli line`. Ye command repo mein pehle se hai. `memo show <id>` se poori detail dekh sakte hain.

## Aaj kya kaam karta hai
- `init`, `setup claude`, aur ab se hone wale sessions ka capture kaam karta hai.
- Purane sessions ke liye maine ye verify nahi kiya ki `memo cycle` ka sweep unhe uthata hai ya nahi. `docs/SUPPORTED_AGENTS.md` ke hisaab se sweep sirf "hooks ne jo miss kiya" wala hissa pakadta hai. Pakka jawab dene ke liye [src/capture/capture.js](src/capture/capture.js) padhna padega.

Chaho to main `capture.js` padhkar bata deta hu ki sweep purane transcripts uthata hai ya nahi, aur `memo import` ko chhote command ki tarah bana deta hu. Pehle code check karke hi bataunga ki kitna kaam hai.

## Saare purane sessions padhna: smart hai, par limit ke saath
**Faida:** pehle din hi project ka context mil jata hai (kya bana, kaunse errors, kaunse decisions). Isse product "kaam ka" lagta hai.

**Dikkat:**
- **Cost aur time:** har session LLM (Groq) se guzarta hai. 200 sessions ek saath bhejoge to token aur wait dono lagenge.
- **Purani info galat ho sakti hai:** 3 mahine purana "TODO" ab ho chuka ho sakta hai. Use "open task" dikhana bura hai.
- **Privacy:** purane sessions mein secrets ya personal baatein ho sakti hain. Redaction hai, par user ko pata hona chahiye ki kya bheja ja raha hai.

**Isliye aise karo:**
1. Default mein sirf **pichle 30 din ya 10-20 sessions** import karo. `memo import --all` alag option ho.
2. Chalane se pehle batao: "14 sessions, andaza ~X tokens, Groq ko bheje jayenge. Continue? [Y/n]".
3. Purane sessions se sirf **decisions aur errors** lo. Tasks ko "unverified" ya "old" mark karo, taaki wo aaj ke kaam jaise na dikhein.

## Claude, Gemini, Codex, Copilot ko kaise pata chalega
Inhe memo ke baare mein pata nahi hota. Har tool ek **instruction file** padhta hai, aur hum us file mein ek line likhte hain: "Pehle `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` padho".

| Agent | Kaise padhta hai | Humara kaam |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `SessionStart` hook se context apne aap aata hai, plus `CLAUDE.md` | pehle se hai |
| Codex | `AGENTS.md` | `memo init` mein pehle se hai |
| Gemini CLI | `GEMINI.md` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |
| Copilot | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |
| Cursor | `.cursor/rules/` | `memo init` mein ek chhoti file likhni hai |

Ye file-naam mere yaad se hain. Inhe `memo setup` mein daalne se pehle docs se confirm kar lena.

**Fark kya hai:** Claude ko memory **push** hoti hai, yaani apne aap aati hai. Baaki ko sirf instruction file milti hai, to wo **pull** karte hain. Agent chahe to file padhe, chahe to na padhe. Isliye unke liye bharosa kam hota hai, aur capture (agent se naya session wapas memory mein aana) abhi sirf Claude ka hai.

**Ek kaam ki baat:** `PROJECT_STATE.md` ek hi file hai aur sab agents wahi padhte hain. Isliye Claude mein kiya kaam Codex ko dikhta hai, bina kisi website ya UI ke. Model badalna asaan hone ka asli reason yahi hai.

Agle step mein main `memo init` mein Gemini, Copilot aur Cursor ki instruction files likhwa deta hu. Ye chhota kaam hai, aur ek tool se doosre tool jaane ka demo bhi isse chal jata hai.
